Deletes the Service Edge Group for the specified ID.
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/serviceEdgeGroup/:serviceEdgeGroupId

Deletes the Service Edge Group for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

serviceEdgeGroupId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the Service Edge Group.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

Responses
